title: Data Engine Switchboard
user: Python data-product engineers deciding whether a Pandas workload can move to Polars or a streaming engine without silently changing outputs.
smallest_useful_product: A Python-aware CLI that runs declared Pandas and Polars transformations on local redacted CSV/Parquet fixtures, checks value/schema/order parity, samples time and peak memory, and flags known streaming fallbacks.
success_measure: On a seeded suite with three intentional incompatibilities, the tool finds all three and produces a go/no-go report in one command.
constraints: Make float, timezone, null, schema and order semantics configurable
Clearly separate measured facts from heuristics
